#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, os, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)
SUB = "/app/submission/main.py"
PY = sys.executable
D = "/app/tmp/work/perf"
os.makedirs(D, exist_ok=True)

def canon(v):
    return json.dumps(v, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)

def build(nrules, k, matchy, npkts, nflows, W=32, idle=10**9, pl=10**9, seed=1):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    rules = []
    ids = sorted(rng.sample(range(0, 2**31 - 1), nrules))
    for i, rid in enumerate(ids):
        rr = []
        for j in range(k):
            if matchy and i < matchy:
                rr.append([-2048, 2048])
            elif rng.random() < 0.3:
                c = rng.randrange(1, 2049) * rng.choice([1, -1])
                rr.append([c, c])
            else:
                lo = rng.randrange(-2048, 2048)
                rr.append([lo, rng.randrange(lo, 2049)])
        rules.append({"id": rid, "class": rng.randrange(0, 65536),
                      "priority": rng.randrange(-10, 10), "ranges": rr})
    cfg = {"version": 1, "idle_timeout": idle, "packet_limit": pl,
           "prefix_width": W, "rules": rules,
           "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 8}, "gt": {"class": 9}}}
    # workload
    reqs = []
    t = 0
    for f in range(nflows):
        reqs.append({"op": "open", "flow": f, "time": 0})
    per = npkts // nflows
    done = 0
    while done < npkts:
        pkts = []
        for _ in range(min(1024, npkts - done)):
            f = rng.randrange(nflows)
            t += 1
            pkts.append({"flow": f, "time": t, "source": rng.randrange(2),
                         "length": rng.randrange(1, 2049)})
            done += 1
        reqs.append({"op": "chunk", "packets": pkts})
    return cfg, reqs

def run(name, cfg, reqs, extra_tail=()):
    cpath = os.path.join(D, name + ".cfg")
    ppath = os.path.join(D, name + ".prog")
    rpath = os.path.join(D, name + ".req")
    opath = os.path.join(D, name + ".out")
    open(cpath, "w").write(canon(cfg))
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=open(cpath, "rb").read(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    t1 = time.time()
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stdout[:200]
    prog = p.stdout
    open(ppath, "wb").write(prog)
    with open(rpath, "w") as fh:
        for r in reqs:
            fh.write(canon(r) + "\n")
        for r in extra_tail:
            fh.write(canon(r) + "\n")
    sz = os.path.getsize(rpath)
    t2 = time.time()
    with open(rpath, "rb") as fi, open(opath, "wb") as fo:
        p = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "stream", ppath], stdin=fi, stdout=fo)
    t3 = time.time()
    assert p.returncode == 0
    outsz = os.path.getsize(opath)
    print("%-14s compile %.2fs prog %.1f KiB  stream %.2fs  in %.1f MiB out %.1f MiB" %
          (name, t1 - t0, len(prog) / 1024, t3 - t2, sz / 1048576, outsz / 1048576))
    return opath

if __name__ == "__main__":
    which = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "all"
    if which in ("all", "a"):
        cfg, reqs = build(2048, 8, 0, 10**6, 1000)
        run("maxrules", cfg, reqs, extra_tail=({"op": "checkpoint"},))
    if which in ("all", "b"):
        cfg, reqs = build(200, 8, 3, 300000, 200)
        run("matchy", cfg, reqs)
    if which in ("all", "c"):
        cfg, reqs = build(64, 32, 0, 200000, 4096, W=32)
        run("manyflows", cfg, reqs, extra_tail=({"op": "checkpoint"},))
PYEOF
